_comment: One trial = one video. Board frame: mm, origin at the board's (0,0) corner, x along the long edge, y up (same as envs/*.txt). Fields starting with _ are ignored. Remove what you do not need.
name: push01
_env: walls, boxes and base come from here unless given below; walls_mm overrides the walls
_corners_px: pixels of board (0,0), (W,0), (W,H), (0,H); read them off `calibrate.py grid`, or "auto" to detect the largest light/dark quadrilateral
_corners_mm: if the 4 corners are not the board's own: their board positions, e.g. [[100,100],[1425,100],[1425,900],[100,900]] for the inner wall corners
_extra_points: more known points (obstacle corners); they refine the homography and give residuals to check it
_intrinsics: json from `calibrate.py intrinsics` (checkerboard video) to undistort the lens
_camera_height_mm: lens to board; corrects the parallax of the vine centerline and box tops when there are no intrinsics
_base: {"px": [u, v]} also works; heading_deg null = measured from the first 60 mm of vine
_boxes: pose_mm = [cx, cy, theta_deg] roughly; it is refined on the reference frame
_schedule: [curvature 1/m, length grown with it mm] from the first tracked frame: what the vine was built/actuated with. Needed for the fit
_grow_rate_mps: measured free growth speed; null = estimated from the video
_reference_frame: a frame with the board set up and no vine out yet
_diff_mode: abs | brighter (light vine, ignores its shadow) | darker
